glyph_origin: In oracle bone and bronze inscriptions, pictogram (象形): a granary, depicting its roof (亼), a door (戶), and a pit for storing grain (口). Alternatively an ideogrammic compound (會意): 合 (“gather”) + 戶 (“door”) – a warehouse. The component 戶 corrupted into 𠁣 in Qin bamboo slips. This form was inherited in small seal script and was misinterpreted as cognate with the unrelated 食 in the Shuowen Jiezi.
s_page_origin: Variant character of 倉, listed in the Shuowen Jiezi as an "odd character". This variant first appeared in Jin bamboo slips.
shuowen: This form was inherited in small seal script and was misinterpreted as cognate with the unrelated 食 in the Shuowen Jiezi.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 倉; s_page_origin explains the simplified 仓.
